fetch('/api/recordings/1').then(r => r.json()).then(({data:d}) => { if (!d.transcript.text || d.segments.length < 2 || d.recording.status !== 'transcribed') throw Error('transcription incomplete'); window.__seek = d.segments[1].startMs / 1000; return {text:d.transcript.text, segments:d.segments, jobs:d.jobs}; })

new Promise((resolve, reject) => { const a = document.querySelector('audio'); const timer = setTimeout(() => reject(Error('seek/play timeout')), 5000); const check = () => { if (!a.paused && Math.abs(a.currentTime - window.__seek) < 2) { clearTimeout(timer); resolve({target:window.__seek, currentTime:a.currentTime, paused:a.paused}); } else setTimeout(check, 50); }; check(); })
